reviews.text: The staff all seemed to love animals, and they looked at my cat with such kind eyes. They also gave me advice and seemed to be very considerate, making sure I wasn't burdened.

From birth to 19 years, 10 months, and 7 days.

All the veterinarians I've seen have treated my precious dog with such care. They prescribed appropriate medication promptly based on the results of regular checkups, allowing her to live a healthy, happy, and joyful life without any health issues.

I am deeply grateful for the support I received for the incredibly happy days my dog ​​and I had.
